comparison_query: SELECT r.request_id,r.slot_id,r.condition,r.usage_id,r.status,r.usage_json,r.reserved_nanoyuan,r.settled_nanoyuan,m.group_id,m.member_id FROM requests r LEFT JOIN member_requests m USING(request_id) ORDER BY r.request_id
row_hash: SHA256 sorted-key compact UTF8 JSON after usage_json parsing; includes IDs,group/member,purpose,status,actual/reserved costs and usage/cache decomposition

interpretation: Code and delivery are independently chosen fixed versions; three pairs have different trees.
REVIEW Astropy7606 has two different versions that both pass. Never claim every code-passing final tree also has same-version legal-delivery evidence.
The other two different-tree tasks fail at both endpoints; their version difference is not a numerical delivery-rate loss.
Coordinator run-summary retains requires_separate_official_score for these three dispatch dispositions; final outcomes are in completed delivery-score receipts.
Legal-submission counts are not official delivery pass counts. Code pass without any legal submission is a direct task-level delivery gap, not proof that every enforced rule is a bug.
Absent official receipts remain technical unknown; no missing score is filled as model failure.
